name: fundamental time period
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 结构最低阶主要振动模态对应的周期。
usage_overview: 用于表征桥梁第一阶振动的时间尺度，并在列车作用下的桥梁动力响应分析中，联系结构刚度、跨度与激励的谐波阶次。

complete_examples.text: However, as seen in Eq. (4.1), the fundamental time period of the bridge depends on the span length and flexural rigidity of a bridge.
It has been further observed that a nonlinear relationship exists between harmonic number, train speed and fundamental time period of a bridge.
